Privacy e dati — MOX Arena Assistant: Privacy and data — MOX Arena Assistant
MOX raccoglie contributi soltanto dopo u: MOX collects contributions only after explicit consent. The site publishes aggregated statistics and may show an observed decklist after 30 matches with the same variant; it never publishes an individual player's history or identity.
Partite e Draft hanno due consensi separ: Matches and Drafts have separate consents, both disabled on first installation. Enabling one does not enable the other and does not retroactively send anything recorded while it was disabled.

password: l'accesso usa Google o Discord: passwords: sign-in uses Google or Discord and MOX does not manage its own credentials.
Ogni installazione usa un identificativo: Each installation uses a random identifier. The secret required for deletion is stored on the server only as a hash.
Se accedi, conserviamo soltanto l'identi: If you sign in, we store only the OAuth provider identifier, display name and avatar. We do not request or store your Google or Discord email. This data is used only to authenticate the private dashboard and never enters the public meta.
Un'installazione viene collegata all'acc: An installation is linked to an account only with a one-time code and proof of that installation's local secret, even if the user sends no contributions. Authenticated tickets remain in the account; anonymous tickets are accessed through a secret link and protected by Turnstile. Screenshots remain in private R2 storage.
Spegnere un consenso interrompe gli invi: Disabling consent stops future uploads and clears the related online queue without deleting personal statistics stored on the PC.
Il sito non usa cookie pubblicitari o si: The site uses no advertising cookies or profiling systems. The interface uses one dark theme and stores no visual preferences in the browser.

I consigli funzionano sul tuo PC. Partit: Suggestions run on your PC. Matches and Drafts are shared only with their respective consents, which can be revoked in settings.
Le schermate di Arena, le preferenze del: Arena screens, interface preferences and analyses needed to display suggestions are not published. Mox does not send passwords, chat, email, real names or the contents of an opponent's hand.

Il pacchetto contiene set ed evento, seq: The package contains the set and event, pick sequence, offered cards, pool, suggestion policy and, when available, versions of the assembled deck. Complete traces remain in private storage; the site exposes reliable aggregates only.
Tracce incomplete o sospette non vengono: Incomplete or suspicious traces are not deleted automatically: they remain private for diagnostics and are excluded from aggregates.

Cloudflare hosts the API and D1 databases. Complete Draft traces are stored in a private R2 bucket and cannot be accessed from the site; they are deleted automatically after 730 days. Attachments for closed tickets are deleted after 90 days and the entire closed ticket after 365 days. Indexes and matches remain while needed by the project or until the user requests deletion through MOX.
Le statistiche pubbliche restano soggett: Public statistics remain subject to minimum thresholds. A Draft percentage requires at least 100 picks and a game result requires at least 30 linked matches; the meta does not show percentages below 30 matches.
Una decklist osservata precisa viene pub: An exact observed decklist is published when the same variant reaches at least 30 matches, even if the sample comes from a single installation. In that case the card list becomes public, but the site does not publish the installation identity, sender, or player history and does not publicly link the list to a person.
Le liste di riferimento di mox-meta sono: The mox-meta reference lists are a separately curated public catalog: they are not reconstructions of decklists observed from MOX users.

nelle Opzioni di MOX elimina i contribut: in MOX Options deletes contributions associated with that installation from the databases and R2. Local copies remain on the user's computer.
Cloudflare gestisce le normali richieste: Cloudflare handles the standard technical requests needed to deliver the site and API. Card images are requested from Scryfall only for cards the frontend is authorized to show, including public catalog lists and observed decklists that have passed the publication threshold. A protected observed decklist generates no image or hover requests for its cards. As with any external web resource, Scryfall may receive standard technical request data; this data is not added to MOX databases.
